purpose: Complete one outcome-independent, replayable neural lifecycle on the admitted Experiment One retrospective compatibility benchmark.

claim_envelope.positioning: portfolio-first research prototype; not operational wildfire guidance
claim_envelope.benchmark_type: retrospective compatibility benchmark with outcomes known before Experiment Three
allowed: protocol adherence and neural lifecycle completion
descriptive comparison with admitted RBR, canonical U-Net, and constant controls
prohibited: generalization beyond the six admitted events

test.opening_policy: one controlled opening only after three complete accepted training packages, shared threshold selection, replay gates, and explicit Milestone 5 authorization

data.ordering: role patch_ids exactly as listed; no shuffle
data.batching: one fixed four-patch batch per role; batch_size=4
data.targets: state==1 maps to burned 1.0; state==0 maps to background 0.0; all other states are masked and never coerced
data.loss_and_metric_mask: loss_mask==1; input_valid must also be true as asserted by the admitted manifest

normalization.method: per-channel train-only global mean and population standard deviation
normalization.invalid_input_handling: after normalization, set locations with input_valid==0 to 0.0; retain them as invalid in outputs and exclude them from loss and metrics

execution.loss: event-class-balanced masked BCE: mean over present classes within each event, then mean over events
execution.epoch_step: exactly one optimizer step on the fixed four-patch train batch, followed by no-gradient loss and probability inference on the fixed train and validation batches

checkpoint_selection.primary: minimum finite validation event-class-balanced masked BCE
checkpoint_selection.tie: earliest epoch on exact float64 JSON numeric equality
checkpoint_selection.improvement: strictly lower; no tolerance or minimum delta
checkpoint_selection.early_stop: stop after 25 consecutive completed epochs without strict validation-loss improvement; retain and reload the selected checkpoint, never the final in-memory state

threshold_selection.scope: one shared validation-only threshold for all three selected seed checkpoints
ranking: maximize the minimum per-seed per-validation-event class-macro Dice
maximize the median across seeds of validation event-class macro IoU

metrics.zero_denominator: null and excluded only from the containing macro; all admitted events are expected to represent both true classes
metrics.event_class_macro_dice: arithmetic mean of class Dice within event, then arithmetic mean across events
metrics.event_class_macro_iou: arithmetic mean of class IoU within event, then arithmetic mean across events
metrics.seed_aggregation: report every seed; three-seed median is the middle sorted value; never select a best seed

collapse_gates.per_seed_per_event_nonconstant: both background and burned must be predicted on eligible test pixels for every seed and each test event
collapse_gates.finite_outputs: all eligible logits, probabilities, losses, and metrics must be finite
collapse_gates.mask_integrity: no masked or invalid location may contribute to loss or metrics; unlabeled/invalid remains distinct from background

comparators.constant_controls: recompute on the exact Experiment Three metric implementation and masks
comparators.historical_comparators: rehash admitted records and translate their retained predictions through the same metric implementation; do not rerun or tune them

decisions.lifecycle_PASS: all three predeclared runs complete or validly early-stop; selected packages safely reload in fresh processes; training histories, probabilities, predictions, geospatial outputs, metrics, renders, and exact replays verify
decisions.lifecycle_INVALID: a required input, binding, run, artifact, safe reload, or exact replay is missing, mismatched, nonfinite, or protocol-violating
decisions.comparative_PASS: lifecycle PASS; every seed passes every per-event nonconstant gate; and the three-seed median is strictly greater than the strongest constant control on both event-class macro IoU and worst-event macro Dice
decisions.comparative_FAIL: lifecycle PASS with valid comparison evidence that does not satisfy comparative PASS
decisions.comparative_INCONCLUSIVE: lifecycle PASS but a required comparator cannot be validly translated or compared despite valid neural evaluation; do not substitute a favorable subset
decisions.comparative_INVALID: evaluation or comparison violated the frozen protocol or lacks required identity/mask/metric evidence

artifacts.serialization: canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, indent 2, LF, terminal newline; arrays little-endian NumPy without pickle; model state-dict tensors only with weights_only load and strict identity checks
artifacts.custody: all run outputs beneath C:\Projects\Active\burnlens-experiment-three-custody; no model binaries or benchmark arrays committed to Git

exception_policy.allowed_before_test: repair an implementation defect only by retaining the failed attempt, proving the frozen semantics unchanged, rerunning every affected seed from initialization, and issuing a reviewed protocol-conformance correction
exception_policy.forbidden: change architecture, data, split, labels, normalization, loss, optimizer, budget, seeds, checkpoint rule, threshold rule, metrics, collapse gates, controls, or terminal decisions
exception_policy.after_test_opening: no tuning or rescue in Experiment Three; any changed attempt is separately approved Experiment 3B

stage_order: Milestone 3: freeze and validate this protocol without benchmark array values
Milestone 4: one training execution per predeclared seed, validation-only checkpoint and shared-threshold selection, safe reload, and exact replay; no test opening
Milestone 5: one controlled test opening, inference, evaluation, comparator translation, rendered comparison, and terminal disposition
Milestone 6: package, audit, release, verify, and terminally close without extending to Experiment 3B
